claims.claim: USA used ps4 console and pad
claims.evidence: Witness report only shows a wall-mounted flat-screen TV with a reflected screen; no PS4 console, controller/pad, or any console branding is shown.
No PS4 console screen, game list, or storage/menu is shown in the witness report.

risks.risk: The item may be only a TV (or a TV without the PS4/controller/games), so the seller’s bundle claim may not match what’s being sold.
risks.proof: A clear photo/video showing the PS4 console connected/visible (front ports/branding) plus the controller/pad and the TV together.
risks.if_unproven: Price as TV only, with no console/controller/games included.

risks.risk: TV specifications are unknown (screen size and resolution), which strongly affects resale value.
risks.proof: A photo of the TV’s label/brand/model sticker and a shot showing the screen size (inches) or model number clearly.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest likely spec/size based on a generic used flat-screen TV condition.

risks.risk: Screen health is unknown (dead pixels, lines, flicker, backlight faults, burn-in). The screen appears dark with reflections, not a test image.
risks.proof: A video clip playing a bright test pattern (full-screen colors) and a close-up showing no lines/flicker and no dead pixel clusters.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially faulty/untested display until a test pattern confirms it.

risks.risk: Missing accessories/parts (remote control, power cable, stand/bracket completeness, HDMI cables) can reduce usability.
risks.proof: Photos of all included accessories laid out (remote, power cable, HDMI/AV cables) and a shot of the TV ports being used.
risks.if_unproven: Price as missing key accessories (especially remote/power/connection cables).

risks.risk: Audio/speaker condition is unknown; some TVs have weak or non-working speakers.
risks.proof: A short video showing TV audio playing (volume up) and confirming sound output from built-in speakers.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming speakers may be weak or require external audio.

proof_requests: Clear photos of the PS4 console (front and back ports/label) and the controller/pad (buttons visible).
A photo/video of the PS4 game library showing the installed games count (5) on-screen.
TV: close-up of the brand/model label and a photo showing screen size (inches).
TV: video of a full-screen test pattern (colors/lines) to confirm no dead pixels, lines, or flicker.
Photos of included accessories: remote control, power cable, and any HDMI/connection cables.
response.reason: The witness report only confirms a flat-screen TV with unreadable specs and does not show the PS4/controller/games the seller claims. Without proof of the console bundle and TV condition/specs, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
